statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias
The diagnosis codes are I48.0 and I49.9
A mobile cardiac telemetry study, CPT code 93229, is ordered
The service is medically necessary to guide clinical management
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the patient's current benefit plan
